**A test build for the Canadian Ioniq 6 (CEEV) on 260903.** This is a fork build, not
an Open-HMG release. It is 2.2.0-rc.3 plus what is on `main` (the Ioniq 6 on 260206),
plus the CEEV Canada 260903 head unit.

**It is signed with a different author key** (`6ed33151-8b1f-8033-b3a5-5e1134ead3fa`)
than Open-HMG's mod (`7251ce71-…`). HMG-API only updates a mod from the key it was
installed with, so an installed Open-HMG `wireless-carplay-aa` has to be removed first
(its settings are lost; nothing else is). The fork's HMG-API build (1.1.0-rc.2 with
the Ioniq 6 CAN 260903 map) is needed too: Open-HMG's has no map for this head unit,
so the menu hook (`btsettings.projection_helper.open_wireless_page`) stays off there.

## What changed

- `CEEV.CAN.0000.V016.010.260903` is accepted (new `ceev_ca_260903` patch set), so
  the mod no longer says "isn't for this head unit".
- The new patch set has **no result checksum for `featurexml.cfg`** yet: the stock
  file was not available. The engine still keeps the stock backup and restores it
  byte for byte, but it cannot refuse an unexpected result there.

## Not known yet

- Whether this firmware's CarPlay and Android Auto libraries are the ones the native
  recipes were made for (`libautoreceiver_infobank.so` dbfe7bd2…, `libCarPlayCore.so`,
  `libCarPlayAudio.so`, `libCarPlayUtils.so`). A recipe whose library doesn't match is
  skipped, never applied, so wireless CarPlay or Android Auto turn-by-turn may be
  missing until it is checked against a Car Report.
- Nothing here has been tested on a car.
